# AIScripto

> Practical AI Products That Solve Real Business Problems. Autonomous voice agents, offline-first POS systems, and enterprise intelligence software.

## Products

- [Business Analytics AI](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/business-analytics-ai): Zero-code loss prevention overlay and statistical outlier radar.
- [Nexus Agent](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/nexus-agent): 24/7 duplex voice intelligence receptionist and SLA incident center.
- [AI Voice Booking Agent](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/ai-voice-booking): Real-time conversational appointment scheduling with zero double-booking guarantee.
- [POS Fast Food](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/pos-fast-food): High-speed counter ordering with offline payment queue.
- [POS Restaurant](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/pos-restaurant): Dining room floor plans, table management, and Kitchen Display Systems.
- [AI Agent Web](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/ai-agent-web): Website voice & text concierge with knowledge base search.
- [ERP Financial Core](https://www.aiscripto.com/products/erp-financials): Auditable double-entry accounting engine and universal voucher keys.

## Services

- [AI Agents & Automation](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/ai): Production autonomous AI agents, multi-agent workflows and RAG systems connected to business systems.
- [Custom AI Chatbot Development](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/ai-chatbot-development): Chatbots built on your own data, workflows and brand.
- [Custom CRM Development](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/custom-crm-development): CRMs built around your sales process, with AI assistance.
- [ERP Integration](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/erp): Bidirectional ERP, accounting and CRM integration (Infor, Odoo, Salesforce, Agicap).
- [Custom Software Engineering](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/software): Web applications, SaaS platforms and internal tools.
- [Cloud Solutions & Migration](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/cloud): AWS, Azure and GCP migration and FinOps cost optimisation.
- [DevOps & SRE](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/devops): CI/CD, Kubernetes and reliability engineering.
- [Cybersecurity & Compliance](https://www.aiscripto.com/services/security): Penetration testing, cloud security audits, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness.

## Solutions

- [AI Receptionist for HVAC Companies](https://www.aiscripto.com/solutions/ai-receptionist-for-hvac): 24/7 AI call answering and emergency dispatch for HVAC businesses.
